name: MOAG Self-Improvement — v0.8.0
description: MOAG improves itself. Fixes UX gaps discovered during dogfooding.

tasks.name: Show completion banner with next actions
tasks.prompt: In src/ui/dashboard-panel.ts, when all tasks in a plan are completed (status is Idle and all tasks show completed), render a green success banner at the top of the dashboard that says 'All tasks completed!' with 3 action buttons: 'Review Changes' (sends message type 'review-changes'), 'New Plan' (sends 'new-plan'), and 'Export Results' (sends 'export-results'). In src/extension.ts, handle these 3 webview messages: review-changes should run git diff in a new terminal, new-plan should call the existing create plan command, export-results should call the existing export command.

tasks.name: Show clear error reason in dashboard task card
tasks.prompt: In src/ui/dashboard-panel.ts, find where failed task cards are rendered. When a task fails, show the last 5 lines of stderr (or stdout if stderr is empty) directly in the task card as a collapsible 'Error Output' section with a red-tinted background. This way users can see why a task failed without scrolling through the full output log. Truncate each line to 200 characters max.

tasks.name: Show elapsed time per running task in dashboard
tasks.prompt: In src/ui/dashboard-panel.ts, for the currently running task, show a live elapsed timer that counts up (e.g. '2m 15s') next to the task name in the task card. Use a setInterval in the webview JavaScript that updates every second while a task has status 'running'. When the task completes, stop the interval and show the final duration. Make sure to clear the interval when the webview is disposed.

tasks.name: Warn before play if engine CLI is not installed
tasks.prompt: In src/extension.ts, find the cmdPlay function (the main play command). Before calling runner.play(), check if the engine CLI for the first pending task is available by running 'which <command>' or 'where <command>' on Windows. If the CLI is not found, show a warning message 'Engine <name> not found. Install it or change the engine in your plan.' with buttons 'Continue Anyway' and 'Cancel'. Only do this check once per play, not for every task. Use the existing getCommand() method on each adapter to get the CLI command name.
